charge_port.notes: Porsche US: "CCS-equipped ... Macan Electric" (adapter needed for NACS stations).

supercharger_access.notes: US: Porsche NACS DC adapter (free for existing Macan Electric owners, included with MY2026).
Canada: adapter, free for existing Macan Electric owners and MY2026 cars (up to about 135 kW at 400 V NACS).

wheels.notes: Macan 4 Electric (CA/US): Press kit: all Macan models standard 20-inch aero wheels (launch model year 2024; MY2025 release still lists the 20-inch Macan S wheel). Not trim-specific for the Turbo.
Macan 4 Electric (CA/US): 21-inch off-road design wheels offered (optional on every trim).
Macan 4 Electric (CA/US): Press kit: up to 22-inch wheels, staggered fitment, optional.
